scope: Two source-named beta-barrel assay constructs have no authenticated exact assay sequence. The separately retained 8AH9 deposited sequence is associated with 16.1 and is not substituted for either assay sequence.
identity_limits: The 16.1 reference is unperturbed only relative to the selected 16.2/16.1 contrast; its seven earlier substitutions remain in the original construct provider.
16.2 carries both source-declared K49E and S51H; no single-substitution effect is isolated. Position 49 lineage remains V to K to E.
The exact 120-residue deposited 8AH9 sequence and its hash remain available through original source context; no sequence is derived or copied to an assay construct.

selection.numeric: All three selected kinetic parameters for both named variants project directly from the original two-row packet. Printed S/R factors remain source context; no R kinetic parameters are reconstructed.
selection.qualitative: All eight S4 benzoate arms project directly from the original packet with null activity/error values. Four high-dose arms retain visibly lower activity than their same-panel zero-addition arms; all eight retain visibly positive activity. No plot digitization, numeric ratio or significance test.
selection.transfer: The requested 16.1/8AH9 matched ligand-control relation is unassessed at that target; the existing 16.2 qualitative experiment and its source conflict are explicitly assessed and retained.
